_comment: FramePack Image-to-Video (ComfyUI API format, kijai ComfyUI-FramePackWrapper nodes). Follows the official framepack_hv_example bar workflow with environment-justified substitutions: core ImageScale replaces essentials ImageResize+ (not installed), core CreateVideo->SaveVideo replaces VHS_VideoCombine (not installed), and the negative conditioning is ConditioningZeroOut of the positive because the distilled model runs at cfg 1.0. One workflow renders the whole clip; the sampler derives internal sections from total_second_length. Resolution comes from FramePackFindNearestBucket (base_resolution 640), so WIDTH/HEIGHT are advisory only.

_documentation.reference_image_node: 5 -> LoadImage.image ({{REFERENCE_IMAGE}} bare name staged into the ComfyUI input dir)
_documentation.bucket_resize: 6 -> FramePackFindNearestBucket -> 7 ImageScale (lanczos, exact bucket WxH) feeding VAEEncode (10) and CLIPVisionEncode (11)
_documentation.model_node: 1 -> LoadFramePackModel (fp8_e4m3fn quantized checkpoint on the offload device)
_documentation.sampler_node: 12 -> FramePackSampler (total_second_length {{TOTAL_SECONDS}}, steps {{STEPS}}, guidance_scale {{GUIDANCE}}, seed {{SEED}}, gpu_memory_preservation {{ANTI_DRIFT}}; cfg fixed at 1.0 for the distilled model)
_documentation.negative_prompt: 9 -> ConditioningZeroOut(positive): official FramePack practice at cfg 1.0; the negative text prompt is intentionally not wired into the graph
_documentation.save_node: 15 -> SaveVideo (the only output node; CreateVideo fps {{FPS}} = 30 fixed, FramePack's native rate)
